Predicates:
Chases($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x chase y?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?

Facts:
Chases(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) ::: The bald eagle chases the tiger.
Visits(BaldEagle, Dog, True) ::: The bald eagle visits the dog.
Kind(Bear, False) ::: The bear is not kind.
Needs(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: The bear needs the bald eagle.
Needs(Bear, Tiger, True) ::: The bear needs the tiger.
Chases(Dog, BaldEagle, True) ::: The dog chases the bald eagle.
Chases(Dog, Bear, True) ::: The dog chases the bear.
Cold(Dog, False) ::: The dog is not cold.
Needs(Dog, Bear, True) ::: The dog needs the bear.
Kind(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is kind.
Young(Tiger, False) ::: The tiger is not young.

Rules:
Visits($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Chases(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) ::: If someone visits the bald eagle then the bald eagle chases the tiger.
Visits($x, Tiger, True) >>> Needs(Tiger, Dog, False) ::: If someone visits the tiger then the tiger does not need the dog.
Chases(Dog, Bear, True) && Round(Dog, True) >>> Visits(Bear, Dog, True) ::: If the dog chases the bear and the dog is round then the bear visits the dog.
Chases($x, Tiger, True) && Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Needs(BaldEagle, Dog, True) ::: If someone chases the tiger and they chase the bald eagle then the bald eagle needs the dog.
Needs($x, Dog, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: If someone needs the dog then the dog is round.
Visits($x, Dog, True) >>> Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If someone visits the dog then they chase the bald eagle.

Query:
Round(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is round.
